published_source.title: The art of trellis decoding is fixed-parameter tractable
supporting_results: Definition of lattice path in Section 3: ordinary lattice paths use only (1,0)/(0,1)
Definition of lattice path with diagonal steps in Section 3.1: (1,1) is a separate preorder concept
published_source.normalized_statement: If (span(V1)+B) INTER (span(V2)+B)=B, then FS_k(V1 disjoint_union V2,B)=up_k(FS_k(V1,B) OPLUS FS_k(V2,B),B), where OPLUS ranges over ordinary H/V lattice-path joins only.

general_theorem.quantification: FOR_ALL finite-dimensional GF(2) ambient spaces A, finite disjoint subspace arrangements V1,V2 in A, subspaces B<=A satisfying the separation premise, and integers k>=0

join_statistic_semantics.lambda: lambda1 + lambda2 + dim(R1_start INTER R2_start) - dim((L1+R1) INTER (L2+R2))
join_statistic_semantics.ordinary_join_sequence: sample the two input trajectories along an ordinary H/V lattice path and apply the join statistic formula pointwise

local_semantic_mapping.generic_b3_join_statistic: The historical generic B3 join_statistic implements the published pointwise L/R/lambda correction formula.
local_semantic_mapping.generic_b3_path_generator_ceiling: The historical generic B3 lattice_paths/join_trajectories admits diagonal ordinary join steps and is therefore explicitly NOT the corrected semantic path-domain reference.
local_semantic_mapping.corrected_root_join: The corrected root full-refinement producer enumerates ordinary H/V paths only and separately replays the same join correction formula.
local_semantic_mapping.corrected_root_contract: The corrected root SPEC freezes ordinary_join_steps={(1,0),(0,1)}, ordinary_join_diagonal_allowed=false, while extension_preorder_steps separately include (1,1).
local_semantic_mapping.caller_precondition_ceiling: The general Proposition 4.4 separation premise is not automatically proved by a local join call; each induction application requires a bound decomposition/caller separation certificate.
